title: Article 50 — Separation of judiciary from executive

content.overview: Article 50 directs the State to take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State.

sections.heading: Meaning
sections.body: The directive targets organisational separation so that executive officers do not combine with judicial functions in a manner inconsistent with the policy of separation. Implementation has been progressive and statute-driven in the States.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Challenges to combined functions or appointments belong under service law, criminal procedure, or constitutional writ standards — not under a freestanding Article 50 decree.
